messages:
maria: Quick post-canary notes from this morning: 5% gate ran for 45m, unassigned peaked at 1.6% then settled. HS workflow gate prevented early assigns in 92% of cases.

.tom: typo? you mean @tom :)

maria: oops :) yes. tom: good results. what tripped in the remaining 8%?

rachel: digging in 1: two main patterns: 1) enrichment callback arrived after handshake but before reconciliation job, and 2) SF webhook retry delay caused owner_history mismatch.

maria: actions: 1) shorten reconcile window to 10m for canary leads, 2) add CSV export of fallback leads to SalesOps, 3) add `enrich_payload_id` to lead so ML and ops can trace slow enrichments.

tom: also recommend a lightweight dashboard: canary_unassigned_rate, fallback_count, enrich_latency_p95. Alert if unassigned_rate > 1% for 15m.

rachel: agreed. I'll add a test that simulates SF retry backpressure and ensure takeover events append to owner_history with timestamps.

maria: ops-bot: please create a ticket for follow-ups and assign to growth-eng + infra.

ops-bot: Created TASK-4520: "Post-canary routing followups: reconcile timing, CSV export, owner_history fixes" assigned to growth-eng. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/TASK-4520 :white_check_mark:

tom: rollback playbook is ready if anything spikes during the wider rollout: revert gate + set fallback_pool to previous pool and notify SalesOps.

maria: plan to expand to 25% tomorrow after infra deploy and dashboard is live. Will post start time here.

rachel: QA will run three scenarios and share results by EOD: delayed callback 90s -> fallback, duplicate callbacks -> idempotent assign, SF throttled retries -> owner_history audit.

maria: thanks team. ping here when TASK-4520 is updated. :thumbsup:
